messages:
maria (Product PM): Quick sync — Helios Health asked for a fast-path plan: private VPC + BYOK for audit logs + tenant-configurable retention. They want something they can validate for audits within 6 weeks. How feasible is a pragmatic MVP?
raj (Eng): We can do a pragmatic MVP but we need to scope carefully. Minimal: encrypt logs at rest with customer-managed keys (SSE-KMS) + a per-tenant retention flag + export snapshot tooling. HSM and full key-escrow can be later. Rough estimate: 2–3 sprints to change pipeline, plus infra work.
olivia (Security): Agree with MVP scope. Security asks: KMS integration (support customer CMKs), documented key import/rotation process, and audit trails showing key usage. Also need to confirm whether Helios requires GovCloud or specific regions for PHI.
ben (Customer Success): Helios is comfortable with us hosting in our standard regions as long as they bring keys and we provide verifiable audit exports. They explicitly called out 6-month retention minimum for audit evidence.
raj (Eng): From infra side: logging currently streams to internal cluster storage. Migration path: redirect to S3 buckets per-tenant with SSE-KMS. We'll need a tiny proxy to inject per-tenant encryption headers and a migration job for historical logs. Impact: writes will have small latency delta; cost of per-tenant buckets and KMS calls increases.
infra-bot: Created ticket: INF-3127 — "per-tenant S3 logging + SSE-KMS integration" https://redwood.internal/INF-3127 (assign: @raj)
maria (Product PM): Tradeoffs to call out to stakeholders: 1) MVP avoids HSM/escrow (reduces delivery time), 2) retention export available but no long-term cold-archive UI in MVP, 3) limited region coverage at launch. We need Legal + Security signoff on these tradeoffs.
olivia (Security): Also need to include acceptance criteria for SOC2 scope: evidence items must be exportable, immutable, and timestamped. For BYOK, we need a playbook for key revocation scenarios (what happens to retained logs if key is revoked).
raj (Eng): Technical acceptance checklist draft: 
```
- per-tenant bucket created
- logs written with SSE-KMS using provided CMK
- retention flag enforces lifecycle rules (30/90/180/365 days)
- export tool produces a signed, tamper-evident archive (SHA256 + manifest)
- integration test: simulate key rotation and verify read/exports
```
maria (Product PM): Customer asks for timeline — propose: scope & PRD this week, infra spike next week, target internal beta in 6 weeks, customer pilot week 8. Is that realistic?
raj (Eng): If we get prioritization and a dedicated eng pair, yes. The critical path is KMS permissions + S3 lifecycle automation. Need help from Platform (IAM) for cross-account CMK policies.
ben (Customer Success): Helios is flexible on pilot date if we can promise a clear rollback/validation checklist. They want an export run for their internal audit before pilot signoff.
olivia (Security): I'll draft the key revocation/playbook and SOC2 evidence checklist; want to review the export manifest format (sha256 + signer) with Eng.
maria (Product PM): Action items: 1) Raj to update INF-3127 with engineering estimate & spike plan by EOD tomorrow; 2) Olivia to share SOC2 evidence checklist + key revocation playbook by Tue; 3) I'll draft PRD and stakeholder tradeoff doc and route to Legal. If any blockers, ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
raj (Eng): Acked. I'll start the spike and post findings in INF-3127.
ben (Customer Success): I'll prep Helios expectations doc and confirm region constraints by Monday.
infra-bot: Reminder: weekly sync scheduled with Platform on Fridays at 10:00 — adds INF-3127 to agenda.
